mappings.note: Content matches perfectly: Solomon strengthening his kingdom and God being with him.
Content matches perfectly: Addressing the leaders of Israel.
Content matches perfectly: Journey to Gibeon and the Tent of Meeting.
Content matches perfectly: The Ark being in Jerusalem while the Tent was at Gibeon.
Content matches perfectly: The bronze altar and seeking God there.
Content matches perfectly: Offering burnt offerings on the altar.
Content matches perfectly: God appearing at night and asking what to give.
Content matches perfectly: Solomon acknowledging God's kindness to David.
Content matches perfectly: Requesting the promise to David and mentioning the vast people.
Content matches perfectly: The specific request for wisdom and knowledge to judge the people.

The Hebrew text of v11 ends abruptly with 'and you asked for yourself wisdom and' (וַתִּשְׁאַל־לְךָ חָכְמָה וּ), which continues into verse 12. The OSMAIN text splits this sentence across verses 11 and 12 naturally, but the Hebrew numbering forces a split mid-sentence.

This verse completes the sentence started in v11 ('...wisdom and knowledge will be given to you') and includes the promise of riches. It effectively merges the end of OSMAIN v11 and all of OSMAIN v12.
Content matches perfectly: Returning to Jerusalem from Gibeon.
Content matches perfectly: Collecting chariots and horsemen.
Content matches perfectly: Silver and gold becoming common in Jerusalem.
Content matches perfectly: Horses brought from Egypt and Kue.
Content matches perfectly: Prices of chariots and horses and trade with Hittites/Arameans.

This verse contains text not found in the OSMAIN text provided. The OSMAIN text ends at v17 (trade details). This verse introduces a new topic: 'Solomon said to build a house for the name of the Lord and a house for his kingdom.' This corresponds to 2 Chronicles 2:1 in standard Bibles, which is missing from the provided OSMAIN list.

extraContent.description: The verse 'וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה לִבְנֹות בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה וּבַיִת לְמַלְכוּתֹו' (Solomon said to build a house for the name of the Lord and a house for his kingdom) is present in the translation but has no corresponding verse in the provided OSMAIN text, which ends at verse 17.
